per_question_answers.question: What did customers ask to control about project emails, and what controls did Pulse ship?
per_question_answers.expected_answer: Customers asked for a quiet setting for projects they only observe and to choose which boards feed the morning email. Pulse shipped an opt-out for shared boards in the April digest (release-03) and admin tuning of routine project alerts in September (release-08). Whether these met every request is not established.

Status: answered

A customer asked for fewer project emails, saying the digest should mean fewer messages; another asked whether the new controls would also suppress direct mentions. [V2-FB-0354] [V2-FB-0175]

Pulse shipped admin controls to tune routine project alerts, while critical and direct-mention alerts are intended to remain timely. [release-08] It also grouped project summaries by board, with shared boards selected by default and an option for teams to opt out. [release-03]
